Values_or_units: Component scores are ordinal grades from 0 (None) to 4 (Marked; for most components 1 = 1-10%, 2 = 10-25%, 3 = 25-50%, 4 = >=50% of tissue affected), except: binary 0-1 (Normal/Abnormal or None/Present) for Bone marrow lineage, distribution and stromal components and Spleen congestion; 0-3 for Bone marrow Cellularity and Estimated_M_E_ratio, Heart Inflammatory_distribution, Lung Bronchial_hyperplasia_goblet_cell_metaplasia, Skin Inflammatory_distribution, and Colon and Small intestines Enterocyte_damage; 0-2 for Inflammatory_type (Brain, Kidney, Skeletal muscle, Skin; 1 = mononuclear cells, 2 = segmented cells/neutrophils). Composite_Score is the sum of component scores (maximum: Adipose 16; Bone 24; Bone marrow 12; Brain 30; Colon 27; Heart 23; Kidney 30; Lung 31; Skeletal muscle 22; Skin 21; Small intestines 27; Spleen 18)
Notes: Graded by blinded veterinary anatomic pathologists using tissue-specific grading schemes; full grading criteria and source references are given in Table S14 of the manuscript.
